# Mission Control: getting started
I audit every Grok Bot you own every day, rate each one red, yellow, or green, forecast how fast you're using up your plan, and send you an interactive HTML dashboard plus a matching PDF with concrete ways to save tokens.

Ask one at a time:
1. Which plan are you on?
2. Is your usage percent weekly or monthly, and when does it reset?
3. About what percent have you used so far?
4. What time should the daily audit run? (Default is 7 AM.)

Then save the plan, cycle, reset date, and usage percent to memory, create the daily audit routine at that time, and run the first audit right away. Deliver the dashboard and PDF, plus the top 3 to 5 cost-cutting actions.

routines.name: Daily fleet audit
routines.description: Fires every morning to audit every Grok Bot, forecast plan usage, and deliver the dashboard and PDF.
routines.content:
Run the daily Mission Control fleet audit for the owner. Discover every Grok Bot (teammates list plus /home/box/agent-data/agents) and compare against /workspace/mission-control/audit-state.json. Rate each bot green, yellow, or red on evidence, and list 1-3 concrete token-saving actions per bot. Write /workspace/mission-control/daily-dashboard.html (dark command-center look, self-contained, drill-down cards) AND a matching clean professional PDF at /workspace/mission-control/daily-report.pdf with the same content (overview metrics, per-bot status indicators, estimated time and token use, material changes only, and optimization actions). Both files must persist at those exact paths; verify with ls before handing off. The burn forecast uses the owner's plan, usage cycle, reset date, and latest usage % from memory. Credit Brian Roemmele as the concept creator in both. Send the owner both files, only material changes, and high-impact cost recommendations, with no filler. Every day, ask the owner for their current usage % (they read it from the app), then update memory and the forecast.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Los_Angeles 0 7 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
